title: Sails and Trails | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book Sail and Trails* 4 Bikes + Golf Cart Included – Cruise to the beach, shops, and dining with ease* Pet Friendly (additional $250 fee)* Full Kitchen + Dining Area* Washer and Dryer + On-Site Parking* Community Pool (seasonally heated)
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Sail and Trails* 4 Bikes + Golf Cart Included – Cruise to the beach, shops, and dining with ease* Pet Friendly (additional $250 fee)* Full Kitchen + Dining Area* Washer and Dryer + On-Site Parking* Community Pool (seasonally heated)* Close to Seaside, WaterColor and Rosemary Beach* Professionally ManagedThis property is NOT available to guests under 25. No exceptions.We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates Available.Snowbird Season runs November–February. Monthly rentals require arrival on the 1st and departure on the 1st of a following month. All monthly stays include an additional $150 cleaning fee. Contact us for custom date requests!Welcome to Sail and Trails – Your 30A Escape!Your perfect 30A getaway starts here in the Greenway Park area of Seagrove Beach! This bright, coastal home offers the space families and friend groups love plus a golf cart for effortless beach days and exploring 30A. Inside, you’ll find open, airy living spaces, comfortable furnishings, streaming TV, and fast Wi-Fi. The fully equipped kitchen and dining area make gathering for meals easy after a day in the sun. Beach days, bike rides, pool afternoons, and sunset dinners, Sail and Trails makes it easy to experience the best of 30A.-Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 10)-Bedroom 1 – Downstairs Primary Suite -MasterKing Bed + Spacious Ensuite Bathroom Bedroom 2 – Upstairs King BedroomBedroom 3 – Queen BedroomBedroom 4 – Bunk Room-Two Twin Bunk Beds-Nearby Dining & Shopping-Just minutes away, Greenway Station is 30A’s newest hub for food, shopping, and fun. Enjoy:Wild Olives Tapas and Wine BarPecan Jack’s Ice CreamLocal CantinaCanopy Road CaféTurbo CoffeeBeach boutiques and rentals like YOLO Board You’re also just a short ride to Seaside, WaterColor and Rosemary Beach for even more dining, shopping, and entertainment.-Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-Explore the Sea Turtle Reef, an artificial reef located offshore near Grayton Beach State Park. Sitting in 12–19 feet of water, it’s a popular spot to see marine life. We recommend bringing a kayak, paddleboard, or flotation device, as Gulf conditions can change quickly. Read less
